message:
test(safety): the final judgement comes after the host and its reader end, and every launch is judged; a fatal contradiction ends the whole test with its logs kept (test-injection-finding r7, Codex 85f9383 N1 N2)

- N1: E2eInjectionMonitor in three steps -- polling; StopPolling() before the host is ended; Finalize(outputComplete)
  AFTER the producer ended (its job: every process, confirmed) and the reader got its EOF -- the final snapshot judged,
  an output not known complete is INVALID. Every launch stays registered; e2e_injection_final_check_all judges each:
  finalized by its verdict, still running by its output now, abandoned (destroyed unfinalized) -> INVALID; "no live
  monitor" is never "all judged". The structured harnesses (standby, punch, migration, reboot_delegate) no longer
  set reading=false / close the read end before the EOF: the job is ended and confirmed, the reader drains to EOF,
  then Finalize; an unconfirmed end cuts the read and Finalize(false). The file-log harnesses (android, bwe,
  control_deadline, two_dispatcher): StopPolling, the job ended and confirmed, Finalize, then the job closes.
- N2: fatal -- a contradiction in std / winrt / none, or a run_with_client INVALID, ends the WHOLE test there
  (e2e_case_invalid: no further launch, nothing deleted, RESULT: INVALID, exit 2, its child's end said confirmed or
  not); an unconfirmed child end in run / run_with_client is returned and that case's log kept (not deleted at the end).
- e2e_guard_runtime_test 16/16 x3: polling catches power ON / another mode / injectionEnabled=1; the final check alone
  (a monitor that never polled) catches it; a tail after polling stopped is caught by Finalize and, unfinalized, by
  the final check; abandoned and incomplete -> INVALID; a quiet finalized run passes; a case contradiction ends the
  test before the next case, logs kept, the unconfirmed end said; F-a / F-c as before.

Product sources untouched. All affected tests build; guard 20/20, power 27/27, match 9/9, legacy 13/13. Not run.
